title: Discrepancy-Diagnostic-Agent Input
description: Input parameters for GAM vs SSP impression discrepancy diagnosis.

gam_impressions.description: Total impressions recorded by Google Ad Manager (ad server, authoritative source).

ssp_impressions.description: Total impressions recorded by the Supply-Side Platform.

ad_format.description: Ad creative format. Determines format-specific probable causes and investigation steps.

ssp_name.description: Name of the SSP (e.g. 'AppNexus', 'SpotX', 'Prebid', 'Index Exchange'). Used for context in causes and steps.
